name: InterfaceDescriptor

fields.name: name
fields.comment:
name is the name of the interface. It should be a short-name (without
 a period) such that the fully qualified name of the interface will be
 package.name, ex. for the package a.b and interface named C, the
 fully-qualified name will be a.b.C.

fields.name: description
fields.comment:
description is a human-readable description of the interface and its
 purpose.

comment:
InterfaceDescriptor describes an interface type to be used with
 accepts_interface and implements_interface and declared by declare_interface.

name: ScalarDescriptor

fields.name: name
fields.comment:
name is the name of the scalar. It should be a short-name (without
 a period) such that the fully qualified name of the scalar will be
 package.name, ex. for the package a.b and scalar named C, the
 fully-qualified name will be a.b.C.

fields.name: description
fields.comment:
description is a human-readable description of the scalar and its
 encoding format. For instance a big integer or decimal scalar should
 specify precisely the expected encoding format.

fields.name: field_type
fields.comment:
field_type is the type of field with which this scalar can be used.
 Scalars can be used with one and only one type of field so that
 encoding standards and simple and clear. Currently only string and
 bytes fields are supported for scalars.

comment:
ScalarDescriptor describes an scalar type to be used with
 the scalar field option and declared by declare_scalar.
 Scalars extend simple protobuf built-in types with additional
 syntax and semantics, for instance to represent big integers.
 Scalars should ideally define an encoding such that there is only one
 valid syntactical representation for a given semantic meaning,
 i.e. the encoding should be deterministic.

name: BaseAccount
comment:
BaseAccount defines a base account type. It contains all the necessary fields
 for basic account functionality. Any custom account type should extend this
 type for additional functionality (e.g. vesting).

name: ModuleAccount
comment: ModuleAccount defines an account for modules that holds coins on a pool.

name: Params
comment: Params defines the parameters for the auth module.

name: DenomUnit

fields.name: denom
fields.comment: denom represents the string name of the given denom unit (e.g uatom).

fields.name: exponent
fields.comment:
exponent represents power of 10 exponent that one must
 raise the base_denom to in order to equal the given DenomUnit's denom
 1 denom = 10^exponent base_denom
 (e.g. with a base_denom of uatom, one can create a DenomUnit of 'atom' with
 exponent = 6, thus: 1 atom = 10^6 uatom).

fields.name: aliases
fields.comment: aliases is a list of string aliases for the given denom

comment:
DenomUnit represents a struct that describes a given
 denomination unit of the basic token.

fields.comment:

fields.comment:
URI to a document (on or off-chain) that contains additional information. Optional.

 Since: cosmos-sdk 0.46

fields.name: uri_hash
fields.comment:
URIHash is a sha256 hash of a document pointed by URI. It's used to verify that

 Since: cosmos-sdk 0.46

comment:

fields.comment:
Deprecated: Use of SendEnabled in params is deprecated.
 For genesis, use the newly added send_enabled field in the genesis object.
 Storage, lookup, and manipulation of this information is now in the keeper.

 As of cosmos-sdk 0.47, this only exists for backwards compatibility of genesis files.

comment: Params defines the parameters for the bank module.

name: SendEnabled
comment:
SendEnabled maps coin denom to a send_enabled status (whether a denom is
 sendable).

name: Supply
comment:
Supply represents a struct that passively keeps track of the total supply
 amounts in the network.
 This message is deprecated now that supply is indexed by denom.

name: PageRequest

fields.name: key
fields.comment:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
 querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
 should be set.

fields.name: offset
fields.comment:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
 It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
 be set.

fields.name: limit
fields.comment:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
 If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

fields.name: count_total
fields.comment:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
 a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
 count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
 is set.

fields.name: reverse
fields.comment:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

 Since: cosmos-sdk 0.43

name: PageResponse

fields.name: next_key
fields.comment:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
 query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
 there are no more results.

fields.name: total
fields.comment:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
 was set, its value is undefined otherwise

name: Coin
comment:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

 NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
 signatures required by gogoproto.

name: DecCoin
comment:
DecCoin defines a token with a denomination and a decimal amount.

 NOTE: The amount field is an Dec which implements the custom method
 signatures required by gogoproto.

name: IntProto

name: BaseVestingAccount
comment:
BaseVestingAccount implements the VestingAccount interface. It contains all
 the necessary fields needed for any vesting account implementation.

name: ContinuousVestingAccount
comment:
ContinuousVestingAccount implements the VestingAccount interface. It
 continuously vests by unlocking coins linearly with respect to time.

name: DelayedVestingAccount
comment:
DelayedVestingAccount implements the VestingAccount interface. It vests all
 coins after a specific time, but non prior. In other words, it keeps them
 locked until a specified time.

name: Period
comment: Period defines a length of time and amount of coins that will vest.

name: PeriodicVestingAccount
comment:
PeriodicVestingAccount implements the VestingAccount interface. It
 periodically vests by unlocking coins during each specified period.

name: PermanentLockedAccount
comment:
PermanentLockedAccount implements the VestingAccount interface. It does
 not ever release coins, locking them indefinitely. Coins in this account can
 still be used for delegating and for governance votes even while locked.

 Since: cosmos-sdk 0.43

name: ExponentialCalculation

fields.name: a
fields.comment: a defines the initial value

fields.name: r
fields.comment: r defines the reduction factor

fields.name: c
fields.comment: c defines the parameter for long term inflation

fields.name: bonding_target
fields.comment: bonding_target

fields.name: max_variance
fields.comment: max_variance

comment:
ExponentialCalculation holds factors to calculate exponential inflation on
 each period. Calculation reference:
 periodProvision = exponentialDecay       *  bondingIncentive
 f(x)            = (a * (1 - r) ^ x + c)  *  (1 + max_variance - bondedRatio *
 (max_variance / bonding_target))

InflationDistribution defines the distribution in which inflation is

 Model like this:
